propertySets.name: Pset_ProtectiveDeviceTypeAntiArcingDevice
propertySets.definition: Anti arcing device properties used in energy domain. The property set can be used by the predefined type ANTI_ARCING_DEVICE of IfcProtectiveDevice.

properties.name: RatedVoltage
properties.definition: The range of allowed voltage that a device is certified to handle. The upper bound of this value is the maximum.
